_description: Sprint 13 CP-1 — the six scenarios, run on staging with `php artisan answer:gate --engine=agent --persist --set=/var/hr-docs/sprints/sprint-13/eval/cp1.json`. One case per scenario, each in its own fresh session on a test-*@example.com employee. Expectations are deliberately minimal (outcome / reason); the point of CP-1 is the reviewer reading the traces in Historial, not a pass rate. Scenario 5b (a question that tempts a GROUP question) cannot be expressed as a single-turn gate case — a fresh question is settled by the deterministic round 0 before the planner is consulted — so it is run by the two probes in ./probes/ (two-turn.php with the live planner; scripted-group-ask.php with a scripted planner) and recorded in review.md.
